source: USGS/USFS LANDFIRE program, public domain, no known usage restrictions
attribution: LANDFIRE (LF2024), U.S. Geological Survey / U.S. Forest Service
acquisitionMethod: Direct curl GET against the live CONUS WCS endpoint. Succeeded on 1 of 4 attempts in this session; the other 3 attempts failed with transport errors (empty reply / TLS reset), matching the previously logged HTTP 502 instability.
approximateAreaDescription: Small rural bbox near Clear Creek County, Colorado, chosen only because it lies inside CONUS coverage and is a low-risk arbitrary test AOI, not because it relates to any benchmark fire
resolvedValidationGap: Originally, this real response's returned bbox differed from the requested bbox by more (~0.007-0.012 deg) than validateLandfireFuelRasterGeometry's strict-equality tolerance, and its resolution reported a positive y-component (geotiff.js's ModelTransformation sign convention) where the validator required negative. Both were traced to real causes, not tolerance tuning: (1) live GeoServer WCS 1.0.0 legitimately pads/resamples the returned extent to its native grid rather than matching the request exactly -- confirmed across 4 independently-fetched real samples at different locations/sizes, resolution up to ~1.6x coarser per axis, width/height always exact; (2) geotiff.js reports OPPOSITE resolution-y signs for ModelPixelScale- vs ModelTransformation-encoded GeoTIFFs (see node_modules/geotiff/dist-node/geotiffimage.js getResolution()), so sign is not a reliable orientation signal across encodings. validateLandfireFuelRasterGeometry was changed to a containment + magnitude-based check (see src/lib/landfireFuel.js and its tests). All 4 real samples now pass; full test suite and offline validators still pass.
